senses.gloss: [जंह् jaṃ-h, intv. of √ hā, go].
जंहस् jáṃh-as, n. wing, pinion.
जना jan-ā, f. birth, origin.
जान jā́n-a, n. origin, birth-place.
जनंगम janaṃ-gama, m. caṇḍāla.
जननाथ jana-nātha, m. lord of men, king, 🞄prince.
जननान्तर janana‿antara, n. another = former 🞄life.
जनमेजय janam-ejayá, m. N. (terrifying 🞄men).

जनयितृ jan-ay-i-tṛ, m. father;
 -trī, f. 🞄mother.

जनस् ján-as, n. race;
 ind. (-ar,) world lying 🞄beyond Mahar-loka.

जनसंमर्द jana-saṃmarda, m. throng of people;
 🞄-sthāna, n. N. of a part of the Daṇḍaka forest.
जानि jān-i, wife (—˚ a.).

जनिकर्तृ jani-kartṛ, a. (trī) arising;
 producing.

 -trī, f. 🞄mother.
जनितोस् ján-i-tos, ab., g. inf. of √ jan.

जनित्र jan-í-tra, n. birth-place, origin: pl. 🞄parents;
 blood-relations.
जनिष्य jan-iṣya, a. yet to be born, future.

जनेन्द्र jana‿indra, m. chief of men, king;
 🞄-īśa, -īśvara, m. id..
जन्मिन् janm-in, m. creature, man.
जन्युः jány-uḥ, gen. sg. of jáni.
जानन्ति jānanti, m. N. of a teacher.
जानु jā́n-u, (m.) n. knee.

जानुक jānu-ka, n. knee (gnly. —˚ a.);
 m. N..
जानुका jā́n-ukā, f. bringing forth (ac.).

जान्वस्थि jānu‿asthi, n. shin-bone;
